messages:
Maya: quick async round-robin — 1-line please: what shipped, what slipped, top unblock (no meetings).
Alex: shipped: runtime autoscale tuning merged (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/456). Canary started.
Alex: slipped: prefix-cache dedupe — blocked on infra quota, Ken is on it, ETA +5 business days.
Priya: shipped: embeddings batching change rolled to prod for small customers, saw ~18% CPU drop.
Priya: slipped: embed-quantization R&D — accuracy regression in edge prompts, pausing until eval infra fix.
Ken: infra note — quota request filed with cloud, support case #87921, I'll follow up with update here.
Ken: unblock ask for Priya: can you drop a reduced repro of the regression? will attach to the case.
Priya: yes, will post a small prompt set by EOD.
Jordan: SRE update — saw a single runtime OOM during the canary at 03:12 UTC, autoscaler handled it, no customer impact. Adding a short postmortem entry.
Maya: Sam and Alex — do we need a canary rollback threshold (latency or error)?
Sam: suggest rollback if p50 > baseline + 30ms OR error rate > 0.5% for 5m.
Alex: ack — I'll add those thresholds to the deploy job.
Maya: owners: please add a single-line next step (owner + ETA) so PMs can update roadmap sprint card.
Alex: next: monitor canary for 24h, then full rollout if green. owner: Alex, ETA: Tue 11am PT.
Priya: next: repro + eval run posted, owner: Priya, ETA: today 6pm PT.
Ken: next: quota escalation follow-up, owner: Ken, ETA: tomorrow 3pm PT.
Jordan: next: postmortem stub + metrics, owner: Jordan, ETA: today EOD.
Maya: quick CR pings: Alex — can you ping @Priya on the autoscale PR for the config snippet change?
Alex: done — @Priya added to review.
Maya: small ask from PM side — if anything slips beyond a week, flag here so we can reassign.
Priya: noted. if quant eval still failing tomorrow I may request help.
Sam: reminder — please include the short change summary in the PR descriptions (user impact + risk). Helps audit.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime-v2 (canary id: c-20260318-01). Logs: https://deploys.redwood/inference/c-20260318-01
Maya: thanks all. I'll compile these into the quarter tracker later today. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks — will post alerts to #eng-oncall if anything spikes.
Priya: will update the eval thread once repro lands.
Ken: will update support case with link to repro when Priya posts.
Maya: end — tiny follow-up: if you changed ownership, reply here so I can update the tracker.
Alex: no ownership changes.
Priya: no change.
Ken: no change.
Jordan: no change.
Sam: switching off for the afternoon, ping me if urgent.
